popup.noImages: No suitable images found on this page
popup.notSupported: This page does not allow scripting
popup.screenshotHint: Translating the snapshot; results will appear on the page. Do not scroll during capture.

selectHint.rectangle: Drag a rectangle over the area — translation starts right away, no need to keep it on screen. More areas work the same, Esc resets
selectHint.oval: Drag an oval over the speech bubble — translation starts right away, no need to keep it on screen. More areas work the same, Esc resets
selectHint.lasso: Trace a freehand outline around the area — translation starts right away, no need to keep it on screen. More areas work the same, Esc resets

overlay.undoRegionHint: Remove the most recently added area

options.title: Image Translator — settings
options.modelHint: local/tesseract works offline; cloud models need API keys on the backend
options.privacy: Privacy: images are sent only to YOUR configured backend URL.
options.engineHint: AI Vision sends the image straight to your chosen provider — no server needed. Autonomous mode runs everything in the browser. Save to apply.
options.aiKeyHint: Stored locally in this browser profile and sent only to the provider you selected.
options.aiPrivacy: Privacy: the cropped image goes directly to the selected AI provider. No third-party server is involved.
options.nativeHostEnable: Use the native Tesseract host for OCR
options.nativeHostHint: Requires the native host to be installed (native_host/install_host.bat) and Tesseract on PATH. Used by the autonomous engine instead of the in-browser OCR worker.
options.ocrLangsHint: Select installed OCR languages. Translation source language does not install models automatically. Missing selected models stop recognition.
options.ocrQualityHint: How many preprocessing variants to try per image; the most confident result wins.
options.japaneseOcrLayoutHint: Auto detects vertical Japanese text. Horizontal disables vertical grouping; Vertical forces top-to-bottom, right-to-left grouping.
options.cloudOcr: Cloud OCR of the selected region (uLanguage-style)
options.cloudOcrHint: The cropped region is sent to backenster.com; on any failure the local Tesseract takes over. Full-page scan always stays local — that is where bubble coordinates come from. The image leaves your browser to a third-party server.
options.cloudTranslate: Translate on the same server (single request)
options.cloudTranslateHint: The server returns the finished translation lines; when unchecked the recognized text goes to your chosen translation engine.
options.mtHint: Models are included in the offline extension build; the autonomous engine does not download them at runtime
options.offlinePackMissing: Offline assets were not found. Run npm run vendor and rebuild the extension.
options.vendorHint: For a fully autonomous build: run npm run vendor, then npm run build. The extension will not access the internet at runtime.
options.pollinationsModelHint: Free OpenAI-compatible vision model (default: openai — accepts images).
options.pollinationsKeyHint: Free key at https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys — required to translate images. Stored locally in this browser profile.
options.openrouterModelHint: Router openrouter/free picks a free vision model on its own. Free model ids rotate, so the router is the stable default; a pinned id can go stale.
options.openrouterKeyHint: Free key at https://openrouter.ai/keys — no card needed. Stored locally in this browser profile.
options.externalMtHint: Sends the recognized TEXT (not the image) to an external service. Off by default — the autonomous engine stays offline.
options.yandexCloudApiKeyHint: Service-account API key (AQ...) from Yandex Cloud with the ai.translate.user role. Stored locally in this browser profile; only the recognized text is sent.
options.externalMtPriorityHint: "External first" skips loading the local NMT model while the service is reachable; on failure the downloaded local model is used.
options.customAiBaseUrlHint: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible Vision endpoint (e.g., Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, OpenRouter).
options.permUrlRequired: Please enter a valid URL first
options.bubbleShapeHint: Style of comic speech bubbles rendered over detected text boxes
options.ocrMinConfidenceHint: Minimum confidence level (0-100) for text boxes and speech bubbles. Default: 40.
options.translateConcurrencyHint: Number of images processed at once (1-5). 1 is recommended for local engine.
options.translateConcurrencyRecommended: 1 is recommended for local engine to prevent UI freezes.
options.groqPresetHint: Sets the Custom AI endpoint and model. A different provider’s key is not copied. Enter your Groq key, grant endpoint access and save. Images are sent to Groq only when you request translation. Free tier is limited; manga quality is not guaranteed.
options.ocrPackMissing: OCR resources for the selected languages are missing. Install an OCR-enabled build or run npm run vendor:ocr and rebuild.
options.ocrExternalReady: OCR resources are ready. External text translation is selected; a local Opus-MT model is not required.
options.localMtMissing: OCR is ready, but local translation models are missing. Select Google/another external translator or install the full offline pack.
options.offlinePackReady: OCR and local translation resources are installed.
options.mtOptionalHint: These local models are optional with an external translator. They are needed for fully offline translation or a local fallback.
options.ocrOnlyVendorHint: Lightweight OCR build: npm run vendor:ocr, then npm run build. Images are recognized locally; recognized text is sent to the selected external translator.
options.ocrDownloadHint: OCR models download only when clicked, from tessdata.projectnaptha.com. No images are sent there. Select the language after installing; OCR then works offline. Translation models are separate. File sizes vary; insufficient storage causes a download error. For Japanese manga install jpn and jpn_vert.
options.ocrDownloadPermissionDenied: Permission to access the model download site was not granted.

local.errPairMissing: Model {{pair}} is missing — download it in settings
local.errModelLoad: Failed to load the translation model
local.errOcrLangMissing: OCR language packs missing: {{langs}} — enable bundled languages in settings
local.errOcrPackMissing: Offline OCR assets are missing. Run npm run vendor and rebuild the extension.
local.errModelPackMissing: The offline translation model pack is missing. Run npm run vendor and rebuild the extension.
